verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's docs describe AI incident summaries that are generated as soon as an incident is declared. These can be tailored to stakeholder audiences, and a runbook can post to Slack when a new summary is ready. A FireHydrant Scribe joins Zoom and Google Calendar bridges to capture discussions and decisions, so responders don't have to take notes. Missing for 10: explicit AI-drafted live stakeholder or status-page updates during the incident (the AI drafting shown is for post-incident retrospectives), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the summaries and Scribe.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI writes the incident as it happens — live summaries, drafted updates, and scribed call notes — so responders respond instead of typing

citations.quote: Summaries are created as soon as an incident is declared, providing key information right from the start.
